lines.t: Verse 1
Before the first sunrise, before the oceans roared
A plan of love was spoken, a promise from the Lord
Beyond all generations, before the dust was formed
Salvation’s fire was kindled, a covenant reborn
Verse 2
Then into our darkness, a holy light appeared
Born into the silence, the One the heavens feared
In flesh You walked among us, yet carried something more
The hope of every nation the world was waiting for
Chorus
Four steps of redemption, one story of grace
Foreknown in the heavens, revealed in time and space
Completed on the cross where the veil was torn apart
Forever sealed in power, now alive inside my heart
Verse 3
The cross stood in the shadow of all our guilt and pain
Yet there You chose to carry what we could never claim
It wasn’t just a moment, it changed eternity
The weight of every sin was nailed there willingly
Verse 4
The grave thought it had won, the stone was standing still
But death was never stronger than Your unyielding will
Morning broke in glory, the earth began to shake
And life rose up victorious, no power left to take
Bridge
Ordained before beginning
Fulfilled in holy birth
Finished in surrender
Resurrected life on earth
Chorus
Four steps of redemption, one story of grace
Foreknown in the heavens, revealed in time and space
Completed on the cross where the veil was torn apart
Forever sealed in power, now alive inside my heart
Outro
And I will stand in wonder, through every passing age
The story never fading, written on every page
From before time’s beginning to endless victory
Your salvation’s forever alive in me
